lead.question: 作家口中的“漂亮地毯”究竟是什么？为什么他还得踩着它进出房间？
lead.warmup: 刚搬进新家本是高兴事，可作家有一千多本书。他想把新房间收拾整齐，奋战一上午仍未完工；房间又小，书只能暂堆地板，铺得寸土不留，进出都得踩着走。妹妹上楼一瞧，竟把这一地书夸成“我见过的最漂亮的地毯”。
goals: 复述搬家整理房间的全过程，抓住“满地图书被夸成地毯”的幽默反转
掌握 temporarily、inch、space、actually、own、spare、gaze at 等核心词语
熟练运用 get/put ... in order、to make matters worse、at the moment、not ... at all 等结构
辨析现在完成时与现在完成进行时的差别，掌握最高级后接 ever + 现在完成时的用法
lead.summary: 课文以“刚搬进新房子、忙了一上午”开篇，点出整理房间之难：藏书千余册，房间又小，书只能暂放地板，铺满每一寸地面，作家进出都得踩着书走。几分钟前妹妹帮忙把旧书橱抬上楼，进门看见满地图书大吃一惊，却夸它是“我见过的最漂亮的地毯”，还劝他不必再买书橱。
lead.tips: I have been trying to get my new room in order 用现在完成进行时，强调持续整理、至今未完；若说 I have tried 只表示“试过”。

questions.q: What is the writer's carpet made of?
questions.zh: 作家那块“地毯”是用什么做成的？
questions.a: It is made of books — the thousand-odd books he has temporarily put on the floor, which now cover every inch of floor space.
questions.aZh: 它是用书做成的——就是他暂时堆在地板上、铺满每一寸地面的那一千多本书。
questions.hint: 见第 3—4 句与第 7 句。

questions.q: Why has it not been easy to get the new room in order?
questions.zh: 为什么把新房间收拾整齐并不容易？
questions.a: Because he owns over a thousand books and, to make matters worse, the room is rather small, so the books have been temporarily put on the floor.
questions.aZh: 因为他有一千多本书，更糟糕的是房间还相当小。

questions.q: What did the writer's sister do a short while ago, and how did she react?
questions.zh: 几分钟前妹妹做了什么？她进屋后有何反应？
questions.a: She helped him carry one of his old bookcases up the stairs; going into his room, she got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
questions.aZh: 她帮他把一个旧书橱抬上了楼；走进房间看到满地是书，大吃一惊。

questions.q: Why does the writer say 'I have been working' rather than the present perfect?
questions.zh: 为什么用 I have been working 而不用现在完成时？
questions.a: The present perfect continuous stresses that the action has been going on all morning and is still unfinished, while 'have moved' simply states a completed result.
questions.aZh: 现在完成进行时强调动作持续了一上午且尚未结束。

questions.q: Why does the sister say 'You don't need bookcases at all'? Where does the humour lie?
questions.zh: 妹妹为什么说“你根本用不着书橱”？妙在哪里？
questions.a: Because the books already lie over the whole floor like a carpet; by praising the mess as the prettiest carpet she has ever seen, she turns his failure to tidy up into a compliment.
questions.aZh: 因为书已像地毯一样铺满地面；她把一片狼藉夸作“最漂亮的地毯”，把收拾失败的窘境变成了赞美。
questions.hint: 把第 7—8 句与第 2—4 句对照读。

exercises.q: 语法填空：We ______ just ______ (move) into a new house and I ______ ______ ______ (work) hard all morning.
exercises.note: 搬入已完成，干活持续至今。

exercises.q: 汉译英（用 get ... in order）：我一直在设法把我的新房间收拾整齐。
exercises.a: I have been trying to get my new room in order.

exercises.q: 汉译英：更糟糕的是，房间还相当小，所以我暂时把书放在了地板上。
exercises.a: To make matters worse, the room is rather small, so I have temporarily put my books on the floor.

exercises.q: 选词填空（temporarily / inch / space / actually）：I have ______ put my books on the floor. They cover every ______ of floor ______ and I ______ have to walk on them.
用 It has been ... since 改写：My sister helped me carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs a short while ago.
exercises.a: It has been a short while since my sister helped me carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
exercises.note: since 从句用一般过去时。

exercises.q: 课文原句填空：You don't need bookcases ______ ______. You can sit here in your ______ ______ and read the ______!
汉译英：这是我见过的最漂亮的地毯。
exercises.a: This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen.
exercises.note: 最高级 + ever + 现在完成时。

quiz.q: 作家口中的“漂亮地毯”实际上是什么？
options: A real Persian carpet
Over a thousand books lying on the floor
A large old bookcase
A new woollen blanket

quiz.q: 他为什么暂时把书放到地板上？
options: The room is rather small.
He has sold all his bookcases.
The floor is warmer than the shelves.
His sister asked him to do so.
quiz.note: to make matters worse, the room is rather small。

quiz.q: “I have been working hard all morning”强调什么？
options: An action that began this morning and has continued till now
A single action finished long ago
A habit formed in childhood
An action that will start tomorrow
quiz.note: 现在完成进行时强调持续。

quiz.q: 课文中表示“此刻、目前”的短语是哪一个？
options: A short while ago
All morning
At the moment
In one's spare time

quiz.q: “They cover every inch of floor space”中 inch 在句中的含义是什么？
options: Every bit of the floor, from one end to the other
A piece of furniture in the room
A kind of old book
A small corner near the door

quiz.q: 妹妹走进房间后说了哪句话？
options: “This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen.”
“You have far too many bookcases.”
“Let me help you tidy the room.”
“The floor needs cleaning at once.”
